lines.zh: 我在深温水里飘，水压把我的身子压得更软。
lines.en: I drift in deep warm water, and the pressure makes me softer still.

lines.zh: 我没有骨头，走起来只能一扭一扭。
lines.en: I have no bones, so I can only waddle and twist.

lines.zh: 往下三十格，光已经很淡了，我还在往下。
lines.en: Thirty blocks down the light is faint, and I am still descending.

lines.zh: 我摆动身体，像一块被水流揉皱的布。
lines.en: I wave my body like cloth being kneaded by the current.

lines.zh: 我们三只排成一队，谁也没碰谁。
lines.en: The three of us line up and never touch.

lines.zh: 深水很安静，我的动作也只好慢下来。
lines.en: Deep water is quiet, so my movements slow to match.

lines.zh: 我用身体两侧的褶边推水，没什么声音。
lines.en: I push water with the frills along my sides, almost silently.

lines.zh: 我一路往下，直到沙变得又细又白。
lines.en: I go down until the sand turns fine and pale.

lines.zh: 上浮几乎不用力，水自己把我抬起来。
lines.en: Rising costs me almost nothing; the water lifts me itself.

lines.zh: 我绕开那道热泉，太烫了，会把我煮熟。
lines.en: I skirt that vent; it is hot enough to cook me.

lines.zh: 我贴着岩壁走，背后总得有点东西靠着。
lines.en: I keep to the rock wall; I like something at my back.

lines.zh: 深温水很浑，我一动就看不见自己的尾。
lines.en: The deep water is murky; one move and my tail vanishes.

lines.zh: 我游得歪，可我一直朝着有暖流的方向。
lines.en: I swim crooked but always toward the warm current.

lines.zh: 我们一群最多三只，再多我就记不住谁是谁。
lines.en: We never number more than three; beyond that I lose track.

lines.zh: 我贴着海底的沙沟挪，尽量不扬沙。
lines.en: I creep along a sand trench, stirring as little as I can.

lines.zh: 三只同伴躲在岩缝里，我也挤进去。
lines.en: Three of my kin hide in a crevice; I squeeze in too.

lines.zh: 我停在半水里，任自己慢慢翻个面。
lines.en: I stop midwater and let myself slowly roll over.

lines.zh: 深水里没有风，可我的软皮一直在动。
lines.en: There is no wind down here, yet my soft skin keeps moving.

lines.zh: 我把自己缩成一小团，这样比较省力。
lines.en: I pull into a small ball; it takes less effort.

lines.zh: 周围很暗，我只能听见自己吞水的声音。
lines.en: It is dark around me; I hear only myself swallowing water.

lines.zh: 我在等一股暖流经过，等得快要睡着了。
lines.en: I wait for a warm current, close to falling asleep.

lines.zh: 我的身体会自己轻轻晃，像挂在钩上的布。
lines.en: My body sways by itself, like cloth on a hook.

lines.zh: 深温水一年到头都是温的，这很奢侈。
lines.en: Deep warm water stays warm all year, which is a luxury.

lines.zh: 我想不起上次见到光是哪天。
lines.en: I cannot recall the last day I saw light.

lines.zh: 一只同类贴在我旁边，我们都不说话。
lines.en: A kin presses close beside me, and neither of us speaks.

lines.zh: 我吐出一个小泡，看它一直升到看不见。
lines.en: I release a small bubble and watch it rise out of sight.

lines.zh: 水里悬着很多细小的东西，我懒得去追。
lines.en: Tiny things hang in the water, and I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 我软，所以我从来不硬碰硬。
lines.en: I am soft, so I never meet anything head-on.

lines.zh: 我把身体摊开，尽量占住这一小片暖水。
lines.en: I spread myself out to claim this small pocket of warm water.

lines.zh: 这里的安静是有重量的，压在我身上。
lines.en: The quiet here has weight, and it rests on me.

lines.zh: 你潜下来的时候，我的身体先缩了一下。
lines.en: When you dive down, my body flinches first.

lines.zh: 你的灯很亮，我全身透明的部分都照出来了。
lines.en: Your lamp is bright and shows every transparent part of me.

lines.zh: 你从上面下来，我在你眼里大概只是团影子。
lines.en: You come from above; to you I am probably just a shadow.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，你的气泡一串串往上去。
lines.en: I look up at you, and your bubbles stream upward.

lines.zh: 你停在离我两格的地方，我也停住。
lines.en: You stop two blocks away, and I stop too.

lines.zh: 你伸手过来，我的软皮立刻塌下去一块。
lines.en: Your hand comes close, and part of my soft skin caves in.

lines.zh: 深水里很少来人，我看了你很久。
lines.en: Few come this deep; I watch you for a long time.

lines.zh: 你身上有岸上的味道，闻起来很干。
lines.en: You carry the smell of land, and it seems very dry.

lines.zh: 我慢慢绕到你背后，那里比较暗。
lines.en: I drift around behind you, where it is darker.

lines.zh: 你走的时候，水纹要很久才平。
lines.en: After you leave, the ripples take a long time to settle.

lines.zh: 你的刀陷进我的身体，又慢慢被推出来。
lines.en: Your blade sinks into me and is slowly pushed back out.

lines.zh: 我流出的东西是透明的，很快就散在水里。
lines.en: What I bleed is clear and disperses quickly.

lines.zh: 疼的时候我会缩紧，缩成很小的一团。
lines.en: In pain I tighten into a very small ball.

lines.zh: 我没有硬的地方，所以每一下都直达深处。
lines.en: I have nothing hard, so every blow reaches deep.

lines.zh: 你砍断了我一截边，它还在往下漂。
lines.en: You cut off a piece of my edge, and it drifts away.

lines.zh: 我躲进岩缝，可我的身体太宽了。
lines.en: I try a rock crevice, but my body is too wide.

lines.zh: 这一下让我整个身子都在抖。
lines.en: That blow leaves my whole body trembling.

lines.zh: 我不喊，深水里喊也没人听见。
lines.en: I do not cry out; no one would hear this deep.

lines.zh: 你打得很准，我的软皮挡不住任何东西。
lines.en: Your aim is good; my soft skin stops nothing.

lines.zh: 我慢慢往下沉，疼得不想再动。
lines.en: I sink slowly, too sore to move again.

lines.zh: 你手里的食物在深水里散开，味道很清楚。
lines.en: The food in your hand spreads through the deep, distinct and clear.

lines.zh: 我靠近一点，又缩回去，来回好几次。
lines.en: I come closer, shrink back, and repeat several times.

lines.zh: 我从下面接住碎屑，软软地含住。
lines.en: I catch the crumbs from below and hold them softly.

lines.zh: 这点东西够我慢慢消化好几天。
lines.en: This much will take me days to digest slowly.

lines.zh: 你撒下的食物沉得很慢，正好落在我嘴边。
lines.en: Your food sinks slowly and lands right at my mouth.

lines.zh: 我用身体的一角把它包住，慢慢收进口里。
lines.en: I wrap a corner of my body around it and ease it in.

lines.zh: 我不争抢，深水里也没有谁跟我抢。
lines.en: I do not scramble; nothing down here competes with me.

lines.zh: 你喂我，我就会一直跟着你的灯。
lines.en: Feed me and I will keep following your lamp.

lines.zh: 我吃得很慢，你别急着收手。
lines.en: I eat slowly, so do not pull your hand away yet.

lines.zh: 这一口下去，我的身体鼓了一小圈。
lines.en: One bite and my body swells a little rounder.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，先陷进去的是我的身体。
lines.en: You bump me, and my body gives way first.

lines.zh: 我太软了，撞上你像撞上一团湿布。
lines.en: I am so soft that hitting you feels like wet cloth.

lines.zh: 我被你推得转了三圈才稳住。
lines.en: You shove me into three spins before I steady.

lines.zh: 我贴在你的腿上，一时忘了松开。
lines.en: I press against your leg and forget to let go.

lines.zh: 你踢了我一下，我整个人凹了进去。
lines.en: You kick me, and my whole body dents inward.

lines.zh: 深水里撞到东西，通常是我自己没看清。
lines.en: When I bump something down here, it is usually my own bad eyes.

lines.zh: 我不疼，只是被挤得变了形。
lines.en: It does not hurt; I am only squeezed out of shape.

lines.zh: 你的脚蹼碰到我，我像被水草缠了一下。
lines.en: Your flipper brushes me, and I feel briefly tangled.

lines.zh: 我顺着你的动作滑开，没有反抗。
lines.en: I slide away with your motion, offering no resistance.

lines.zh: 撞完我们各自漂开，谁也不记仇。
lines.en: We drift apart afterward, holding no grudge.

lines.zh: 我们在深水里贴着，谁也没用力。
lines.en: We press together in the deep without either of us pushing.

lines.zh: 她的动作比我还慢，我很喜欢这一点。
lines.en: She moves even slower than I do, and I like that.

lines.zh: 我们两只一起往下沉，沉了很久。
lines.en: The two of us sink together for a long while.

lines.zh: 我把身体绕过去，替她挡了一点冷水。
lines.en: I curl around to shield her from a patch of cold water.

lines.zh: 我们的小群最多三只，我们占了其中两只。
lines.en: Our group holds at most three, and we are two of them.

lines.zh: 她的软皮碰到我的，我抖了一下。
lines.en: Her soft skin touches mine, and I twitch.

lines.zh: 我们并排漂着，像两块同色的布。
lines.en: We drift side by side like two lengths of the same cloth.

lines.zh: 她先动了，我才跟上，永远慢半拍。
lines.en: She moves first and I follow, always half a beat behind.

lines.zh: 这一层暖水是我们的，往下就是冷的了。
lines.en: This layer of warm water is ours; below it turns cold.

lines.zh: 她走了以后，我还在原地漂了很久。
lines.en: After she leaves, I drift in place for a long time.

lines.zh: 有东西慢慢沉下来，我用身体接住了。
lines.en: Something sinks slowly, and I catch it with my body.

lines.zh: 我包住那块石头，又觉得没意思，松开了。
lines.en: I wrap around that stone, lose interest, and let go.

lines.zh: 深水掉下来的东西，多半来自很远的地方。
lines.en: Things that fall this deep usually come from far away.

lines.zh: 我卷着一片鳞，不知道是谁掉的。
lines.en: I curl around a scale without knowing whose it was.

lines.zh: 你的东西沉下来了，我推到岩缝里。
lines.en: Your gear sinks down, and I push it into a rock crevice.

lines.zh: 我没有口袋，只能含在嘴里。
lines.en: No pockets down here; I simply hold it in my mouth.

lines.zh: 这块骨头比我还轻，我推着它走了一段。
lines.en: This bone is lighter than I am, so I push it along a while.

lines.zh: 我捡到的都会再掉，软皮抓不住东西。
lines.en: Whatever I pick up falls again; soft skin cannot grip.

lines.zh: 我把那枚珠子含了一会儿，凉得很舒服。
lines.en: I hold that bead a while; its coolness is pleasant.

lines.zh: 捡东西这件事，对我只是顺手。
lines.en: Picking things up is only incidental for me.

lines.zh: 我锁定的不是你，是你灯下的那点光。
lines.en: What I have marked is not you but the glow beneath your lamp.

lines.zh: 你手上的食物味散开了，我朝那边去。
lines.en: The food smell from your hand spreads, and I head that way.

lines.zh: 我很少盯住什么，这次是个例外。
lines.en: I rarely fix on anything; this is an exception.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的灯走，灯灭了我就停。
lines.en: I follow your lamp and stop when it goes out.

lines.zh: 你在深处停下来，我也停下来看着。
lines.en: You stop deep down, and I stop to watch.

lines.zh: 这个目标会动，我跟得有点吃力。
lines.en: The target moves, and following it tires me.

lines.zh: 我没有恶意，我只是想靠近那点亮。
lines.en: I mean no harm; I only want to be near that light.

lines.zh: 你踢起的水混了，我靠味道找你。
lines.en: Your kicks muddy the water, so I track you by smell.

lines.zh: 我把自己调成和你一样的方向。
lines.en: I turn myself to match your heading.

lines.zh: 你走远了，我还在往那个方向漂。
lines.en: You are long gone, and I still drift that way.

lines.zh: 我慢慢升起来，离你的灯近了一格。
lines.en: I rise slowly, one block closer to your lamp.

lines.zh: 我在你下面绕，光把我的影子投到岩壁上。
lines.en: I circle beneath you, and the light throws my shadow on the wall.

lines.zh: 你一动，我的身体就跟着转。
lines.en: When you move, my body turns to follow.

lines.zh: 我张开的身体挡了一点你的视线。
lines.en: My spread body blocks a little of your view.

lines.zh: 我在等你的手再伸过来一点。
lines.en: I wait for your hand to reach a little closer.

lines.zh: 你退，我不追，只是继续漂着。
lines.en: You retreat; I do not chase, only keep drifting.

lines.zh: 深水里没有直线，我绕着弯靠近。
lines.en: There are no straight lines down here; I approach in curves.

lines.zh: 我把最软的那一面朝向你。
lines.en: I turn my softest side toward you.

lines.zh: 你听见的水声，是我在调整方向。
lines.en: The sound you hear is me changing direction.

lines.zh: 再近半格，我就能碰到你的脚蹼。
lines.en: Half a block closer and I will touch your flipper.

lines.zh: 我把整个身体压过去，几乎没有力气。
lines.en: I press my whole body against you with almost no strength.

lines.zh: 这一下更像拥抱，不像攻击。
lines.en: That felt more like an embrace than an attack.

lines.zh: 我缠住你的手腕，然后不知道下一步。
lines.en: I wrap your wrist and then have no next move.

lines.zh: 你被我一挤，只晃了一下。
lines.en: One squeeze from me and you only sway.

lines.zh: 我打人不疼，这是我一直知道的事。
lines.en: My blows do not hurt; I have always known that.

lines.zh: 我用软皮拍你，声音比力道大。
lines.en: I slap you with soft skin; the sound is louder than the force.

lines.zh: 你推我，我就黏在你手上不放。
lines.en: You push me away, and I cling to your hand.

lines.zh: 我唯一的重击，是整只压上来。
lines.en: My only heavy blow is lying on you entirely.

lines.zh: 打完之后我先累了，缩到一边。
lines.en: Afterward I tire first and shrink aside.

lines.zh: 你别怕，我连壳都没有。
lines.en: Do not fear me; I do not even have a shell.

lines.zh: 我在深温水里张开身体，四周一片暗蓝。
lines.en: I unfurl in deep warm water, surrounded by dim blue.

lines.zh: 一出生我就往下沉，浮起来太费劲。
lines.en: I sink at birth; rising costs too much.

lines.zh: 身边有一两只同类，我们自然地靠在一起。
lines.en: One or two kin are near, and we settle together naturally.

lines.zh: 这里的光少得可怜，我索性不看。
lines.en: There is precious little light here, so I stop looking.

lines.zh: 我的身体一开始很小，软得像一滴水。
lines.en: I start out tiny, soft as a drop of water.

lines.zh: 我第一件事是找一个能靠着的岩壁。
lines.en: My first task is finding a rock wall to lean on.

lines.zh: 深水压着我，我倒觉得这样很稳。
lines.en: The deep presses on me, and I find it steadying.

lines.zh: 我慢慢学会摆动，第一次就撞上了石头。
lines.en: I learn to undulate and hit a rock on the first try.

lines.zh: 这一层水是温的，我决定不出去了。
lines.en: This layer is warm, and I decide not to leave it.

lines.zh: 我出生时没有声音，这里也不需要声音。
lines.en: I was born without sound, and this place needs none.

lines.zh: 热水从上面压下来，我的软皮缩成一团。
lines.en: Hot water presses down from above, and my soft skin balls up.

lines.zh: 我摔在浅滩上，身体摊成一薄片。
lines.en: I land on the shallows and flatten into a thin sheet.

lines.zh: 离开水，我的软皮开始往内塌。
lines.en: Out of water, my soft skin begins to collapse inward.

lines.zh: 爆炸的震动穿过水，我整个人被抖散了一下。
lines.en: The blast's shock crosses the water and shakes me apart for a moment.

lines.zh: 箭穿过我，留下一个很快就合上的孔。
lines.en: The arrow passes through me, leaving a hole that closes fast.

lines.zh: 药水的味道钻进我的身体，我整只都变涩了。
lines.en: Potion vapor seeps into my body and leaves me bitter all over.

lines.zh: 我已经很久没吃东西，身体薄得能看见水。
lines.en: I have not eaten in days; I am thin as paper.

lines.zh: 雷声传到这里只剩闷响，我却抖了很久。
lines.en: The thunder arrives muffled down here, and I tremble for a long time.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有压力，我的身体反而胀开了。
lines.en: The void has no pressure, and my body swells open.
